Dhātup. xxiv, 2; but in Ved. and ep. poetry also pres. वधति; Pot. वधेत्; fut. वधिष्यति, ˚ते; other Ved. forms are aor. अवधीम्, व॑हीम् Subj. वधिषः; बधीः, TĀr.; Prec. बध्यासम्, ˚सुः, AV.),
to strike, slay, kill, murder, defeat, destroy, RV. &c. &c.:
Pass. वध्यते, ˚ति (aor. अवधि), to be slain or killed, MBh.; Kāv.; &c. :
Caus. वधयति, to kill, slay, MBh. [a. Gk. ὠθέω.]
